g.text: RIPPLES IN SPACETIME · REAL DETECTOR NOISE
Standard inference assumes Gaussian, stationary noise — but real
LIGO, Virgo and KAGRA data break that with glitches and drifting lines.
R. Legin, M. Isi, K. Wong, A. Adam, L. Perreault-Levasseur, Y. Hezaveh
Université de Montréal · Mila · Ciela · Flatiron Institute · Perimeter Institute
